programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Efter næsten at have mistet livet i “Daredevil” er superheltinden ELEKTRA tilbage i en verden af drab og bedrag – stærkere, smukkere og smidigere end før, men hendes ofre når knap at opfatte, hvad der sker. Hendes mission er at dræbe, og hun er effektiv.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Provence
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In India
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: CIIE special: China's evolving role in the global market
programme.desc: As consumer demand and imports continue to expand, the Chinese market is becoming more than a sales destination - it is also a hub for business growth and innovation.During the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE), CGTN's Vivienne Nunis talks with Manish Jain, regional general manager of IKEA China, and Krister Zackari, executive vice president at Fazer Group. They discuss the opportunities China offers global brands, how the market is shaping business strategies and supply chains, and the value of the CIIE for both returning exhibitors and first-time participants.

programme.title: Dialogue at the world's largest port: Building resilient port cities together
programme.desc: How can port cities stay resilient amid global trade uncertainty? A sub-forum of the Global Mayors Dialogue in Ningbo was held at the Ningbo Zhoushan Port — the world's No.1 port in cargo throughput for 17 straight years. CGTN's Michael Wang spoke with Ningbo's Vice Mayor and guests from Cotonou (Benin), Klang Royal City (Malaysia) and Toamasina (Madagascar). Arctic shipping routes, green corridors, sister-port cooperation — the insights keep coming.

programme.title: Smart governance, shared future: How innovation is changing our cities
programme.desc: Robots that write, grasp objects and work on real production lines are becoming an everyday reality in Ningbo. How is innovation transforming our cities? From humanoid robots and smart urban governance to balancing tourism in Florence and developing a digital city atlas in Egypt, the future is already here. Learn more at this sub-forum of the Global Mayors Dialogue in #Ningbo. #Zhejiang.

programme.title: Code and the kiln's glow

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or "Five Terraces." The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Celebrating Shuyang Festival in the Longji Rice Terraces
programme.desc: The Longji Rice Terraces in Guangxi are renowned for their magnificent scenery and unique cultural value. Julian Waghann from the United States and Eliza Arce from the Philippines arrived at the cloud-wrapped Longji Rice Terraces to take part in the most solemn annual farming festival: the Shuyang Festival. From the moment they stepped onto the terraces, they walked along the narrow ridges, joined the ancient seedling-combing ritual, sampled distinctive local cuisine, and lifted torches at nightfall to parade and pray with the villagers through the shimmering paddies. Through these vivid scenes, they gradually came to understand the centuries-old symbiotic relationship between the local..

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or "Five Terraces." The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Celebrating Shuyang Festival in the Longji Rice Terraces
programme.desc: The Longji Rice Terraces in Guangxi are renowned for their magnificent scenery and unique cultural value. Julian Waghann from the United States and Eliza Arce from the Philippines arrived at the cloud-wrapped Longji Rice Terraces to take part in the most solemn annual farming festival: the Shuyang Festival. From the moment they stepped onto the terraces, they walked along the narrow ridges, joined the ancient seedling-combing ritual, sampled distinctive local cuisine, and lifted torches at nightfall to parade and pray with the villagers through the shimmering paddies. programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer..

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead.

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: Western icon Roy Rogers, along with his trusty companion Trigger, are back for another adventure. This time, a respected judge is being framed for murder by a crooked saloon owner. Always the valiant champion, Rogers vows to clear the name of the judge and find the truth all while courting a lovely beau. Cellist turned editor turned Republic Pictures workhorse Joseph Kane takes the reins of this rousing, musical adventure, which features a number of original songs performed by Rogers himself, with the help of singer-songwriter Bob Nolan and character actor Smiley Burnette (TVs Petticoat Junction).

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks.

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

Join us as we explore street food, markets, and culinary workshops that highlight the region rich gastronomic heritage.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Granada
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Granada, in Spain’s Andalucía region, discovering its rich history, vibrant culture, and world-famous charm. She visits the stunning Alhambra, enjoys a delicious tapas tour, and experiences the passion of flamenco. Granada’s blend of Moorish heritage and modern energy makes it one of Spain’s most captivating cities. Special thanks to Gayle for an incredible tapas tour.

programme.title: Outdoor and Nature
programme.desc: OUTDOOR & Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus.

programme.title: Made in Med: Honey and Beekeeping
programme.sub-title: S01:E04 Made in Med: Honey and Beekeeping
programme.desc: For five generations, Rebecca Busuttil's family has shared a deep connection with beekeeping. Balancing her work as a full-time beauty therapist and beekeeper, Rebecca introduces Fadi to the fascinating world of bees and their vital role in our ecosystem. From working among the hives to sampling a variety of seasonal honeys, Fadi gains a first-hand look at the dedication, knowledge, and care that beekeeping requires, while discovering just how intelligent, adaptable, and essential bees are to our everyday lives.

programme.title: Twist in the Tail Tiny Home
programme.desc: In the charming town of Equi Terme, nestled in a dramatic valley famous for its thermal baths. The tiny house at the end of the street promised charm, but the tour had a few surprises! With one bedroom upstairs, a kitchenette, a tiny living room, and multiple terraces, it’s perfect for lovers of unspoiled nature or avid climbers, though the spiral staircase might not be for everyone. Stick around as we explore the delightful borgo itself.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Milan
programme.desc: Malini Angelica visits Milan, in northern Italy’s Lombardy region. Known for its chic style, stunning architecture, delicious food, and world-class art, Milan stands out as one of Europe’s most fashionable and sophisticated cities.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Just south of Naples, we'll experience the breathtaking Amalfi Coast, including trendy Positano, the limoncello charms of Sorrento, the ancient Greek temples at Paestum, and the Blue Grotto hidden beneath the enchanting Isle of Capri.

programme.title: Whats On - 14 - Waves and Rhythms
programme.desc: From seaside beats to floating stages, this episode captures Mediterranean music by the water. Malta Boomerang Festival and Earth Garden celebrate eco conscious music and arts, while Spain Bilbao BBK fuses urban culture with live performances. Set sail on the Mediterranea Metal Cruise, a unique floating festival, and enjoy Malta iconic Jazz Festival with historic and coastal backdrops. The Mediterranean truly comes alive where music meets the waves.

programme.title: Concerto - Schubert e Strauss per Mariotti e OSN
programme.desc: The Rai National Symphony Orchestra, under the baton of conductor Michele Mariotti, presents a captivating performance featuring the works of Franz Schubert and Richard Strauss. The programme showcases Schubert's rich melodies and lyrical compositions alongside Strauss's dynamic and expressive pieces, offering a journey through the Romantic and late-Romantic musical landscapes. The orchestra's interpretation highlights the depth and emotional power of these renowned composers, creating a memorable concert experience.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Wake up your Body
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Memoirs 27 Nov
programme.desc: Memoirs 27 Nov.

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The origin of the Egyptian God Cards is finally revealed! The mysterious Shadi takes Yugi on a journey back in time to the creation of Duel Monsters… and the dangerous powers it released.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Odion’s Embodiments of Apophis run roughshod over Joey’s monsters… and his life points! Can Joey effectively utilize the monsters he won earlier in the tournament, or is he already too flustered to mount a successful counterattack.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: It’s a feeding frenzy as Odion’s Serket devours Joey’s monsters to morph into greater and powerful stages of evolution! How can Joey defeat Serket when it ingests Joey’s monsters whenever they’re summoned on to the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Odion uses a phony Egyptian God Card to summon the third Egyptian God Monster The Winged Dragon of Ra and targets it to annihilate the rest of Joey’s life points! However, is Odion able to control the ultimate power of an Egyptian God, or will The Winged Dragon of Ra punish all those unworthy of summoning it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 1
programme.desc: The third duel of the Battle City Finals between Mai and Marik is no ordinary duel; it’s a battle in the dreaded Shadow Realm where losing life points equals losing your memories! As Marik’s true sinister self comes to the surface, does Mai stand a chance against this malevolent evil.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 2
programme.desc: As Mai loses more and more of her memories under Marik’s relentless assault, she loses confidence in her dueling abilities. Will Yugi and friends’ neverending support bring her back to victory, or will her shattered mind be trapped in the Shadow Realm for eternity.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 3
programme.desc: Mai gains control of Marik’s The Winged Dragon of Ra, but she’s unable to decipher how to unleash its massively powerful abilities! Can Mai solve the mystery of the Egyptian God Card before Marik solves it himself and incinerates Mai with the full fury of The Winged Dragon of Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 1
programme.desc: In the fourth duel of the Battle City Finals, Kaiba’s mystery opponent is… Ishizu! With the power of her Millennium Necklace, Ishizu can see the future, including every card Kaiba is planning to play! Does Kaiba stand a chance against an opponent who knows his moves even before he does.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 2
programme.desc: Ishizu, using the magic of her Millennium Necklace, has already seen the outcome of the duel – she will defeat Kaiba with her trap! How can Kaiba win when it’s already destined that he will lose? It’s time for Kaiba to change the future.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: As Marik’s evil grows, Ishizu reveals the secrets of her bloodline: How did Marik transform from a kind child into a power-hungry tyrant out for world domination? Can Yugi save Marik from the edge of darkness, or is he already beyond salvation.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 2
programme.desc: Bakura and good Marik summon The Winged Dragon of Ra, ready to blast and banish evil Marik into the Shadow Realm! But The Winged Dragon of Ra has more than one special ability, and evil Marik knows how to use them all.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: As Kaiba’s blimp speeds towards KaibaCorp Island for the final rounds of the Battle City Tournament, the ship is hijacked by a mysterious boy named Noah and his henchmen – five familiar foes from Yugi and Kaiba’s past who are out for revenge! With the power of cyberspace on Noah’s side, Yugi and friends are trapped inside a new and dangerous Duel Monsters game.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Noah displays the power of his virtual world by splitting up Yugi’s gang and flinging them into the far reaches of his self-created universe! programme.desc: Yugi faces off against Gansley, in the form of "Deepsea Warrior.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Téa is led by a penguin to Crump, in the form of Nightmare Penguin, who challenges her to a duel. She learns immediately that dueling in the virtual realm differs starkly from her previous duels, and starts to succumb to the virtual playing field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Despite gaining a lead with Maha Vailo, Téa falls behind as Crump begins an assault on her life points, causing the ice around her to grow. With the help of her Deck Master, Dark Magician Girl, and Yugi's Dark Magician, Téa gains enough confidence to win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey faces the Big 5's lawyer, Johnson, in a courtroom duel. Joey pulls an early lead with his Deck Master, Flame Swordsman, but Johnson's Deck Master, Judge Man, has abilities of his own.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Tristan, Duke and Serenity duel Nesbitt, the Big 5's mechanical expert. Serenity's lack of experience with the game and Nesbit's powerful machine monsters create a tragic end for Tristan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: With Tristan gone and Serenity in shock, Duke attempts to defeat Nesbitt by himself. But when Orgoth the Relentless is destroyed by his Perfect Machine King, Duke tries to help Serenity regain confidence in her abilities. The two later remember Tristan's face down card, hoping it will help them win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: As Nesbitt (in Tristan's body) kidnaps Mokuba, Kaiba is forced to duel Lector, the former assistant to his stepfather. For Lector, the duel is personal, as he plans to take what he believes is rightfully his—KaibaCorp. Meanwhile, Tristan rejoins the group; his friends do not recognize him, since his mind has been downloaded into a mechanical monkey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

Mokuba's unwavering faith in Kaiba keeps him believing that his brother will pull out with a victory, but Noah has plans to ruin their brotherhood.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Merger of the Big Five — Part 1

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: A King and His Queen S2 E40
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Hitlers Geldgeber: Die Akteure hinter Hitler und der NSDAP
programme.desc: München, 12. September 1919. Ein mittelloser und von Rache getriebener Soldat schreibt an diesem Tag Geschichte. 13 Jahre später feiert man ihn als Retter der deutschen Nation. Sein Name: Adolf Hitler. Wie war es möglich, dass eine kleine nationalistische Partei zur stärksten politischen Kraft Deutschlands aufstieg und ihr Anführer zum Kanzler ernannt wurde? Wer waren die mächtigen und einflussreichen Akteure hinter Hitler und der NSDAP?

programme.title: Hitlers Geldgeber: Hitler und die industrielle Elite
programme.desc: Deutschland, 1937. Mit der rücksichtlosen Durchsetzung seiner Wirtschaftspolitik scheint Hitler sein Versprechen einzulösen, Deutschland innerhalb von vier Jahren zurück zu Wohlstand und Wachstum zu führen. Der Wiederaufstieg hatte jedoch düstere Seiten, und während Deutschland sich in seinem zurückgewonnenen Glanz sonnte, verkauften Hitler und seine Schergen Deutschlands Seele. Diese Folge enthüllt, wie die Nazis mit der finanziellen Unterstützung der industriellen Eliten die Macht übernahmen.

programme.title: Hitlers Geldgeber: Die Arbeitssklaven des Krieges
programme.desc: Mithilfe großer Unternehmen inner- und außerhalb Deutschlands besetzte Adolf Hitler in weniger als vier Jahren halb Europa. Scheinbar neutrale Nationen standen tatenlos daneben und machten sich zu Komplizen des Verbrechens. Zum Auf- und Ausbau des Kriegsapparats der Nationalsozialisten wurden Millionen Menschen versklavt. Sogar mit den sterblichen Überresten und den gestohlenen Habseligkeiten der Opfer wurde noch skrupellos Profit gemacht.

programme.title: Hitlers Geldgeber: Bestrafung und Entschädigung
programme.desc: Mit dem Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs in Europa begann die Verfolgung der Naziverbrecher. Neben dem Wunsch nach Gerechtigkeit stand auch der nach Restitution von Gütern und Wertgegenständen, die während Hitlers 12-jähriger Terrorherrschaft gestohlen wurden, im Vordergrund. Vieles bleibt weiterhin verschwunden und führt zu Verschwörungstheorien und Schatzsuchen. Wurden jene, die Hitler finanziell unterstützten, bei den Nürnberger Prozessen und anderen Entnazifizierungsmaßnahmen angemessen bestraft?

programme.title: Hotel Romantik Sverige
programme.desc: Der bliver bejlet ihærdigt til hotellets 'dronning'. Aftenens par er en glædelig overraskelse for alle. Men et brud mellem et andet par kan ikke forhindres. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mødregruppen
programme.desc: Dansk komedie fra 2019. I Hongkong lever den nybagte mor Line det vilde jetsetliv sammen med manden Bjørn. Da Line opdager, at Bjørn har en affære med barnepigen, rejser hun i raseri til det sidste sted, hendes mand vil lede – nemlig hendes sydfynske hjemby. Hvad der blot skulle have været et kortvarigt ophold, bliver en længere rejse hjem til rødderne og mødet med en sprudlende mødregruppe. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kriminalkommissær Barnaby
programme.desc: "Vild høst". Indsmurt i trøffelolie og bundet til et træ ender den rige godsejer Martin Strickland sit liv som vildsvinefoder. Den bizarre mordsag fører makkerparret Barnaby og Nelson til en gourmetrestaurant, der ejes af den ambiøse og ikke ligefrem elskede mesterkok Ruth Cameron. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sporløs UK
programme.desc: Rachel Burch voksede op i en hvid familie og skilte sig ud i den lille landsby i West Sussex, hvor de boede. Nu har hun behov for at kende sin identitet, derfor forsøger hun at finde sin biologiske far, der er født på Jamaica. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Jørgen Skouboe malker geder til milk shakes og laver flytbare hegn, der giver både læ og skygge i haven. Ovre i udekøkkenet tilbereder Anne Hjernøe gede-spareribs og Jørgens hjemmedyrkede lilla bønner med gedeost. Sendt første gang 17.09.06 (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kontant
programme.desc: En morgen vågner Jesper Hansen og ser chokeret, at nogen har malet store, hvide bogstaver på hans sorte tag: "DETTE TAG ER IKKE BETALT". Han har hyret et firma til at rense og male taget, men ender i en voldsom konflikt med firmaejeren. Kontant undersøger en branche, hvor flere firmaer har højtryksrenset asbesttage uden gyldige dispensationer. Jacob Kragelund møder kunder, der frygter, at farligt asbeststøv har spredt sig på deres grund og spørger tagrenser-direktørerne, hvad det er, der foregår. www.dr.dk/kontant (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Husdrømme
programme.desc: Svensk livsstilsprogram fra 2020. (Husdrömmar) På en mark uden for Höganäs ligger der et tidligere forsamlingshus, som er så uanseeligt, at de nye ejere kalder det Sydsveriges grimmeste hus. Ejerne Amber og Uffe er stærkt uenige om, hvordan det skal lykkes dem at gøre huset fint. Uffe vil rive facaden ned, mens Amber synes, det er både forkert og risikabelt. Så beslutter Gert Wingårdh sig for at vælge side. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Trumps USA
programme.desc: I "Trumps USA" stiller vi skarpt på de afgørende udviklinger, personopgør og dagsordener, der udspiller sig i amerikansk politik. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bo Widerberg – den svenske mesterinstruktør
programme.desc: Bo Widerberg var en af Sveriges mest indflydelsesrige filmskabere. Den anerkendte og excentriske instruktør og forfatter blev født i Malmø i 1930. Han udgav flere romaner og novellesamlinger, inden han rettede en skarp kritik mod den indadvendte svenske filmkultur og argumenterede for en ny bølge af realisme i filmkunsten. Her dykker vi ned i hans karriere og passionerede jagt på livet, der fik konsekvenser for både hans kolleger, familie og ham selv. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bag om Barbie
programme.desc: Barbie er verdens mest kendte dukke, der lever i en fortryllet og glitrende glamourverden fuld af eventyr. Men under overfladen gemmer der sig en mørk og dramatisk historie. Her undersøger vi hemmelighederne bag skabelsen af den ikoniske dukke og hendes ekstraordinære liv. En fortælling om milliarder af kroner og om kamp og forræderi mellem hendes mor og far – de to skabere Ruth Handler og Jack Ryan. (Dokumania) (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Den totale krig
programme.desc: Krigen går ind i sin sidste og mest afgørende fase. I juni 1944 gennembryder de Allierede nazisternes Atlantvold ved D-dag, mens Den Røde Hær knuser den tyske modstand i øst. Paris bliver befriet, Berlin falder, og Nazityskland kapitulerer. Men i Stillehavet fortsætter kampene, indtil USA kaster atombomberne over Hiroshima og Nagasaki. En ny verdensorden tager form, men har menneskeheden lært, hvor skrøbelig freden er? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Værtshushistorier
programme.desc: I 1970 er værtshuset Drop Inn centrum for Københavns bohemer – og stedet, hvor det storstilede eksperiment Thy-Lejren bliver født over en flok øl. Men for eksperimentets bagmand udvikler lejren sig katastrofalt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Deadline
programme.sub-title: Helte og skurke i Silicon Valley
programme.desc: Silicon Valley er hele verdens omdrejningspunkt lige nu. Og midt i det hele står de ultrarige techchefer, der bliver hyldet som visionære helte og afskyet som magtsyge skurke. Hvorfor har de fået den her nærmest mytiske status i vores samfund og populærkultur? Og er et oprør i gang? Sandra Brovall søger svaret i Deadline. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Deadline
programme.desc: Klimatopmødet endte i søndags med, at mere end 130 lande forlod forhandlingerne i protest mod de store olienationer. Verden over bliver årets COP31 set som endnu et alvorligt tilbageslag for den globale klimakamp. Så er det tid til at gentænke hele vores tilgang til klimapolitik? Det spørger vi Bjørn Lomborg og EU's klimakommissær Dan Jørgensen om. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Deadline
programme.desc: Højrefløjen jubler over Mette Frederiksen. Forleden brugte statsministeren nemlig udtrykket "en stor befolkningsudskiftning" – et begreb, som ellers i årevis har været tæt knyttet det yderste højre og især til den etnonationalistiske bevægelse Generation Identitær. Hvad gør det ved den offentlige debat, og hvad gør det ved det danske samfund, at landets statsminister nu taler på den måde? Christian Bennike spørger talsmanden for Generation Identitær og Socialdemokratiets værdiordfører i Deadline. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hvornår var det nu det var?
programme.desc: Dansk quizprogram fra 1993. Gorm viser klip fra DR's arkiver i forsøget på at få årstal ud af quizdeltagerne. Se bl.a. den nybagte All England-mester Sven Pri og det påbegyndte privathospital Mermaid Clinic. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sprogquizzen
programme.desc: Dansk program fra 2015 Hvad er en æblefis? Var en bommerøf i gamle dage det samme som en syngende lussing? Hvilket stykke bagværk betyder halvmåne på fransk? Og hvem har opfundet ordet Langtbortistan? Gæt med, og få både lattermusklerne og hjernen motioneret, når Sprogquizzen med Maria Månson som vært dykker ned i det danske sprog og quizzer i dialekter, noget nyt, noget gammelt, noget lånt og noget tegnet. Aftenens deltagere er Rie Helmer Nielsen, Julie Hastrup, Adrian Lloyd Hughes og Mikkel Frey Damgaard. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Det danske filmmirakel
programme.desc: Alt kulminerer med Dogme 95! Nye skuespillere, nye instruktører og Lars von Trier som katalysator. Men dogmebevægelsen var først og fremmest et opgør med den omfattende teknik, som filmfolk var ved at blive kvalt i – store kameraer, dikterende lyssætninger og kæmpe kulisser stod i vejen for den gode historie. Men ved at fjerne alle de snærende bånd fra filmproduktionen, kunne dansk film slå vingerne ud og med den frihed fløj utallige stortalenter både foran og bagved kameraet højt op på himlen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.title: Pesadilla en Elm Street 5: El niño de los sueños
programme.desc: Alice Johnson cree haber derrotado para siempre a Freddy Krueger, pero el asesino regresa de la forma más inesperada. Utilizando los sueños del hijo que Alice espera, Freddy encuentra un camino para renacer y comenzar una nueva ola de terror en Springwood. Mientras sus amigos caen víctimas de pesadillas cada vez más macabras, Alice descubre que la única forma de detenerlo es enfrentarse a él en el mundo onírico de su hijo no nacido. En una batalla contra el tiempo, Alice tratará de revelar los secretos del origen de Freddy para impedir su regreso definitivo.

programme.title: Ouija
programme.desc: Un grupo de adolescentes trata de hablar con una amiga que ha fallecido recientemente. Para ello se trasladan al lugar donde murió y, con la ayuda de una güija, intentan contactar con ella. Sin embargo, convocan sin querer a una oscura presencia. Stiles White, reconocido técnico de efectos especiales y guionista de películas de terror como 'Boogeyman: La puerta del miedo', se estrena en la dirección de un largometraje con esta película de su género fetiche. Para ello toma como eje principal la güija, un polémico juego dado a conocer por los espiritistas del siglo XIX y que la empresa Hasbro empezó a comercializar en la década de 1960. Con un presupuesto limitado -algo más de 4 millones de euros- White narra la pesadilla que vive un grupo de jóvenes que deberá enfrentarse a sus miedos más profundos cuando viven situaciones paranormales. La cinta está protagonizada por un reparto de jóvenes actores entre los que destacan Olivia Cooke ('Bates Motel'), Ana Coto ('DisCONNECTED'), Daren Kagasoff ('Vida secreta de una adolescente'), Bianca A. Santos ('Happyland'), Douglas Smith ('Big Love') y Shelley Hennig ('Teen Wolf').

programme.title: The Descent
programme.desc: En un viaje dedicado al deporte de aventura en las montañas Apalaches, seis chicas quedan atrapadas en una cueva cuando una roca se desprende y bloquea la salida. Mientras buscan una escapatoria en el laberinto de túneles, las chicas se ven perseguidas por una raza de hambrientos depredadadores que una vez fueron humanos, pero que se han adaptado monstruosamente a la vida en la oscuridad. El acecho en la oscuridad va a poner a prueba su resistencia y su amistad.

programme.title: Cuando acecha la maldad
programme.desc: En un pueblo remoto, dos hermanos encuentran un cuerpo mutilado junto a un misterioso diario en los límites de su propiedad. Decididos a descubrir la causa de la muerte, siguen la pista hasta un podrido, un hombre infectado por un demonio que trata de darse a luz a sí mismo en una granja de las proximidades. Los dos hermanos deciden deshacerse de él, pero, desconociendo los ritos adecuados del exorcismo, lo único que consiguen es desatar el infierno al desencadenar una epidemia de posesiones en su comunidad rural. Ahora deben escapar junto a sus familias de la maldad que corrompe y mutila a todo hombre, mujer y niño expuesto a ella con la ayuda de una marchita limpiadora que posee las únicas herramientas que pueden detener esta plaga sobrenatural.

programme.title: Tales from the Void
programme.desc: A Sawyer nada le gustaría más que pasar la noche en la enorme y pija casa de su nueva mejor amiga, Nola. Sin embargo, la casa de Nola tiene normas que deben cumplirse. Normas que ocultan un oscuro secreto que llega cada noche a las 3:03 AM.

programme.title: Hay algo en el bosque
programme.desc: Tras robar una joya conocida como 'La Piedra de Mor', los hermanos Cosme y Saray Garza se encuentran con Koldo Ugartetxe, el mafioso que les encargó el trabajo, en unas cabañas perdidas. Los hermanos intentarán estafar a Koldo entregándole una falsificación perfecta de la joya. Parece que todo va a ir bien, hasta que Koldo y sus dos secuaces llegan a las cabañas y empiezan a sospechar de los hermanos.

programme.title: Hay algo en el bosque
programme.desc: El popular influencer, Markel Allende, llega a las cabañas para una promoción. En un paseo descubre una planta viviente , una mandrágora, que podría relanzar su carrera. Lo que parece un éxito peligra cuando Markel presenta a su 'nueva amiga' en sus redes. Markel corre el riesgo de ser cancelado por su audiencia y que su mayor hater encuentre la excusa perfecta para atacarle en la vida real.

programme.title: La rebelión de las máquinas
programme.desc: 1986, durante tres días, la Tierra está bajo la influencia de un misterioso cometa que dota de vida a las máquinas. Éstas se ponen en funcionamiento y aterrorizan a los humanos. Viven unas horas de verdadera angustia, en las que tienen que parar a tan horribles máquinas, antes de que éstas acaben con ellos.El exitoso escritor de terror Stephen King se atrevió, en esta ocasión, a llevar a la pantalla un relato propio como director de cine. Después de la adaptación de la práctica totalidad de sus novelas, King se asoció con Dino De Laurentiis para plasmar en pantalla grande el cuento corto ''Trucks''. Esta historia sobre la rebelión de las máquinas frente al poder humano, que contó con un joven Emilio Estévez como protagonista, no consiguió, sin embargo, el éxito esperado. Aquí en España, por ejemplo, se estrenó fugazmente tres años después de su filmación, para pasar directamente al formato video.

programme.title: Llama un extraño
programme.desc: Jill, una joven estudiante que por las noches trabaja de canguro cuidando a unos niños, comienza a recibir una serie de llamadas amenazadoras. Al otro lado del teléfono solo una pregunta: ''¿has vigilado a los niños recientemente?''. Asustada llama a la policía, que identifica el origen de las llamadas en la misma casa. Cuando Jill se dirige al cuarto de los niños a su cargo, descubre que han sido asesinados mientras dormían.Un regular psycho-thriller, realizado en pleno auge del género, cuando ''La noche de Halloween'' había sentado las bases definitivas de este tipo de historias. ''Llama un extraño'', quizás la película de mayor reconocimiento de su director, Fred Walton, está dividida en tres partes: en la primera, el asesino mata a unos niños y es detenido antes de que haga lo mismo con la niñera, en la segunda escapa del manicomio y en la tercera, la niñera verá amenazada su vida de nuevo.

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: En plena epidemia zombi, un tren surcoreano de alta velocidad parte de Seúl hacia Busán, quizá el último refugio libre de infección. En el tren viajan el ocupado Seok-woo con su hija Soo-an. Progresivamente, el virus se va extendiendo por los vagones y el espacio libre de contagios se va reduciendo. Al tiempo, las imágenes del exterior a través de los móviles o de los cuerpos de muertos que se lanzan contra los cristales del tren. El caos colapsa el sistema ferroviario y un paisaje apocalíptico que recorrer a pie y atravesando la oscuridad es la última esperanza.

programme.title: Señales
programme.desc: El predicador Graham Hess pierde la fe en Dios tras la muerte de su esposa en un brutal accidente de coche. Vive con sus hijos y su hermano en una granja. De repente, empiezan a aparecer círculos en los cultivos de su maíz; Graham los atribuye a simples trastadas. Pero, tras escuchar ruidos extraños y ver noticias sobre círculos similares en todo el mundo, la familia empieza a sospechar de actividad alienígena. Ahora deberán mantenerse unidos y volver a creer para sobrevivir y escapar de la amenaza.

programme.title: extra 3
programme.desc: 1976 von Dieter Kronzucker erfunden, legt „extra 3“ beständig den Finger in die Wunde. Ob falsche Wahlversprechen, Finanz- und Wirtschaftsskandale oder dämliche TV-Magazine, die Beiträge entlarven politischen und gesellschaftlichen Irrsinn auf so witzige, intelligent-makabre Weise, dass das Einschalten immer wieder lohnt.

programme.title: Die Carolin Kebekus Show
programme.desc: Mit viel Biss und klarem Standpunkt macht Carolin Kebekus den großen Gleichberechtigungs-Kassensturz für das Jahr 2026 und beweist, warum Feminismus weiterhin unverzichtbar ist – und dabei sogar richtig Spaß machen kann. Unterstützung bekommt sie im Studio von Schauspielerin, Regisseurin und Drehbuchautorin Karoline Herfurth, während Autorin Giulia Becker ironisch nach dem nächsten austauschbaren Schwiegermutter-Liebling für die deutsche TV-Moderation sucht. \n\nDazu nimmt Kebekus skurrile Adventstrends wie Hunde-Weihnachtsmärkte aufs Korn und wagt sich in das wohl gefährlichste Terrain der Vorweihnachtszeit: die Familien-WhatsApp-Gruppe.

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc:

Die Sendung bietet einen kompakten und verlässlichen Überblick über das nationale und internationale Geschehen. Reporterinnen und Reporter sowie Korrespondentinnen und Korrespondenten berichten aus dem In- und Ausland und ordnen aktuelle Entwicklungen verständlich und fundiert ein.

programme.title: Landkrimi: Steirerstich
programme.desc:
Heute bleibt die Küche kalt beim Gruberwirt im steirischen Golling: Koch Mario Höfler liegt nämlich mit durchtrennter Halsschlagader in der Küche. Die Grazer Ermittler Sascha Bergmann und Anni Sulmtaler erfahren, dass das Oper im Restaurant nicht nur am Herd hantierte, sondern auch der Obmann des örtlichen Sparvereins war, der am Vorabend noch eine hitzig verlaufende Versammlung abgehalten hatte. Dies könnte auch die fehlenden 60 000 Euro erklären, die vom Tatort verschwunden sind. 

Bald stellt sich aber heraus, dass Mario doch nicht das große Finanzgenie war, für das ihn viele Vereinsmitglieder hielten. Einige beklagen durch Marios riskantes Anlagemodell hohe Verluste. Ein Mordmotiv? 

Auch mit Halbbruder Karl lag Mario wegen des elterlichen Erbes im Streit. Erfolgreicher war der gut aussehende Hallodri hingegen in der örtlichen Frauenwelt. Denn hier ließ er weniger anbrennen als in der Küche. Eine seiner abgelegten Liebschaften, die wohlhabende Witwe Ingrid Trieber, hatte ihm besonders viel Geld anvertraut. 

Der 14. Fall aus der „Steirerkrimi“-Reihe wartet mit einer Fülle an Verdächtigen auf und kann dadurch die Spannung lange aufrechterhalten. Für Anna Unterberger als Anni Sulmtaler ist dies der letzte Einsatz. Gleichzeitig wird hier auch schon ihre Nachfolgerin Maya Unger als Dorfpolizistin Lena Herzog eingeführt.

programme.title: Mankells Wallander: Verrat
programme.desc: Hat der erfolgreiche Sachbuchautor Erik Wredin (Tobias Zilliacus) seine Frau ermordet? Tochter Amanda (Hedda Stiernstedt), die ihren Vater hasst und zur Mutter ein enges Verhältnis hatte, traut ihm das zu. Nicht nur Ermittler Wallander (Henriksson) setzt Erik unter Druck: Computernerd Tore und seine Freundin haben die Bilder der Überwachungskamera aus Wredins Haus und erpressen ihn…\n\nDer Film präsentiert nur eine kleine Verdächtigenrunde, in der sich die Spannung in Grenzen hält. Aber auch Wallanders Welt wird immer kleiner: Der zunehmend demente Kommissar erinnert sich nicht mehr, wo er sein Auto geparkt hat – und er erkennt auch zeitweise Kollegen und eine Verdächtige nicht wieder.

programme.title: Die Carolin Kebekus Show
programme.desc:
Feminismus ist verbissen, männerfeindlich und im Jahr 2026 längst überflüssig – für alle, die das noch glauben, macht "Die Carolin Kebekus Show" einen Kassensturz zum Thema Gleichberechtigung und zeigt damit: Feminismus muss – auch in Zukunft!

Im Studio begrüßt Carolin eine Frau, die dazu mit ihren Filmen einen wichtigen und auch lustigen Beitrag leistet: Schauspielerin, Regisseurin und Drehbuchautorin Karoline Herfurth.

Autorin Giulia Becker kümmert sich indessen um die Zukunft des deutschen Fernsehens und castet den nächsten x-beliebigen XX-Chromosomenträger, der mit männlichem Schwiegermutter-Charme jedes TV-Format wegmoderieren kann.

Außerdem wird es schon ein bisschen vorweihnachtlich: Carolin nimmt den neuen Adventstrend "Hunde-Weihnachtsmärkte" unter die Lupe. Ob dort auch "Rudolf, the red nosed Retriever" anzutreffen ist? Und sie wagt sich dahin, wo es in der Vorweihnachtszeit wirklich nur die ganz Mutigen aushalten: in die Familien-WhatsApp-Gruppe!

Online gibt es für die Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer ganzjährig zusätzlichen Content von "DCKS" unter @dckshow bei YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp und TikTok.

Produziert wird "Die Carolin Kebekus Show" von der bildundtonfabrik (btf GmbH) in Zusammenarbeit mit der Unterhaltungsflotte TV GmbH im Auftrag des WDR. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Monitor
programme.desc:
Ruanda-Deal: Wegbereiter SPD?

Abgelehnte Asylbewerber sollen ab 2027 von Deutschland nach Ruanda gebracht werden – in sogenannte Return Hubs. Ein Projekt, das CDU und CSU seit Langem vorantreiben. Vom Koalitionspartner SPD kam heftige Kritik. Doch wie glaubwürdig ist die? In der Vergangenheit hat die SPD immer wieder migrationspolitische Positionen geräumt und half auch dabei, zentrale Voraussetzungen für die geplanten Rückführungen nach Ruanda zu schaffen – trotz Warnungen von Juristen und Menschenrechtsorganisationen.

Schleusung auf dem Ärmelkanal: Deutschland als Drehscheibe

Zehntausende Migranten versuchen jedes Jahr, über den Ärmelkanal ins Vereinigte Königreich zu kommen – in völlig überfüllten und untauglichen Schlauchbooten. Viele dieser Boote kommen aus Deutschland. Denn hier ist ein logistischer Knotenpunkt der Schleuserindustrie entstanden. Auch dank einer Gesetzeslücke in Deutschland, die lange offenblieb. Gemeinsame Recherchen von "Monitor" mit WDR, NDR, SZ und einer internationalen Medienkooperation zeigen, wie auch in Deutschland mit der Hoffnung von Migranten viel Geld verdient wird.

Fixierungen bei Polizeieinsätzen: Tragische Fehler oder brutale Eskalation?

Immer wieder enden Polizeieinsätze für Menschen in psychischen Ausnahmesituationen tödlich oder mit schweren Folgen. Experten führen das häufig auf eine Fesselung in Bauchlage zurück, eine besonders gefährliche Fixierungsmethode. "Monitor"-Recherchen zu zwei besonders krassen Fällen zeigen: Polizisten müssten die tödlichen Risiken dieser Fixierung eigentlich kennen – und verstoßen womöglich immer wieder gegen interne Anweisungen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Barbapapa'
programme.desc: Barbazoo vuole fotografare gli animali della foresta. Con stupore riesce ad avvicinarli tutti, ma poi capisce che si tratta di uno scherzo dei fratelli!

programme.title: Barbapapa'
programme.desc: Che fortuna assistere alla danza nuziale di due uccelli del paradiso... Oh no! Barbazoo ha finito la pellicola!

programme.title: Barbapapa'
programme.desc: Nella vegetazione tropicale, la famiglia trova animali e frutti esotici: ogni nuova scoperta e' motivo di meraviglia...

programme.title: Barbapapa'
programme.desc: Nel deserto delle Ande i Barbapapa' rimangono stupiti nel vedere una moltitudine di buchi nella sabbia... da dove hanno origine?

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco mostra a Bing come fare 'buuu' e insieme fanno spaventare Flop, ma per sbaglio Bing terrorizza il piccolo Charlie.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Sula giocano con un taxi parlante cavalcabile ma per sbaglio feriscono Hoppity, cosi' fanno finta di fare gli infermieri e il taxi diventa un'ambulanza...

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: e' una giornata ventosa e Bing vuole far volare Hoppity con il suo aquilone.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: e' l'ora del bagnetto: Bing non resiste e continua ad aggiungere sapone fino ad avere cosi' tanta schiuma da non riuscire piu' a gestirla.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Sula giocano con una polverina magica. Bing vuole far diventare magico il suo sasso, ma all'improvviso starnutisce: la polverina va dappertutto ed e' tutto piu' magico!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing vuole scavare una grande buca e si arrabbia quando Pando la riempie. Tocca a Flop spiegare loro come lavorare insieme.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Flop va a comprare delle carote per il pranzo. Bing decide di restare a casa ma presto comincia a sentire la mancanza di Flop.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Pando hanno lo stesso cestino del pranzo e giocano a scambiarselo, ma diventa meno divertente quando, all'ora di pranzo, si accorgono di avere il cestino sbagliato!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco va dormire a casa di Bing per la prima volta, ma ognuno ha le proprie abitudini ed e' difficile venirsi incontro, ma e' certamente molto divertente!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Sula trovano dei giochini nella macchinetta delle sorprese. Bing pero' non ha trovato quello che si aspettava e rimane deluso...

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing si fa spingere sulla giostra per andare veloce, ma quando prende troppa velocita' si accorge di avere le vertigini.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing costruisce un rifugio con i cuscini del divano per giocare al lupo cattivo con gli amici. Bing fa il lupo e quando gli viene vietato di entrare nella casetta, si arrabbia e la distrugge!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa riceve una scatola dove riporre i suoi pensieri segreti. E Peppa adora i segreti. Ma quando anche George ha una scatola cosi', e Peppa non puo' sbirciare all'interno, non ama piu' i segreti come prima.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Ep.6 di 52 - "Far volare l'aquilone" - Peppa e George, al parco, giocano con l'aquilone insieme a mamma e papà. Ma a un certo punto l'aquilone finisce tra i rami di un albero, e papà cade in una pozzanghera cercando di recuperarlo. Tutti nel fango allora, questo è divertirsi!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Durante un picnic in famiglia, Peppa e George danno da mangiare alle anatre. Una vespa viene però attratta dalla torta e inizia a inseguire Papà ovunque.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Mamma e Papa' Pig trovano in soffitta degli strumenti musicali. Mamma suona il violino, Papa' la fisarmonica e Peppa il tamburo. George invece lascia tutti a bocca aperta quando suona il corno!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa e George giocano nel giardino del nonno. Mentre Peppa fa finta di essere una farfalla, Nonno Pig mostra a George come imitare un verme. Poi tutti e tre saltano dentro le pozzanghere facendo finta di essere rane!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa e George hanno invitato tutti i loro amici oggi e tutti si devono mascherare. Peppa decide di indossare un bellissimo abito da principessa magica e Giorgio si veste da dinosauro.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Mamma Pig compra un paio di scarpe rosse per Peppa e lei le adora tanto da non toglierle mai. Dopo una notte di pioggia, Peppa vorrebbe giocare tra le pozzanghere, ma non puo' con le sue belle scarpine...

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: La famiglia va alla festa della scuola: i piccoli si truccano da tigri e Papà Pig modella un dinosauro con un palloncino, ma l'attrazione preferita resta il castello gonfiabile.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Fa caldo e Bing e Flop si comprano un ghiacciolo, ma Bing si distrae per aiutare una ranocchia finita nella piscina gonfiabile e intanto i ghiaccioli finiscono per sciogliersi!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Sula dipingono un murale e per sbaglio Bing imbratta di colore il disegno di Sula, che si arrabbia. Si accorgono poi pero' che il murale e' cosi' diventato ancora piu' bello!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Flop giocano a nascondino lungo la strada per il negozio. Li' Bing vuole continuare il gioco, ma si nasconde senza avvisare Flop che non riesce piu' a trovarlo...

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Pando fanno un castello di sabbia, ma Pando ci cade sopra distruggendolo. Bing e' dispiaciuto, ma scopre che i castelli di sabbia si possono facilmente ricostruire.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: E' autunno e Bing raccoglie le ghiande nel parco. Si accorge pero' che il suo mucchio di ghiande e' diminuito... che fine hanno fatto le altre ghiande? Flop lo aiuta a svelare il mistero.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing trova le scarpine di quando era piccolo e che ora vanno bene a Charlie, ma nonostante non gli vadano piu' bene, non vorrebbe separarsene.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Flop e' malato e Bing decide di prendersi cura di lui: lo fa accomodare in poltrona e gli legge una storia, ma quando prova a preparargli una tisana, combina un disastro.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: e' l'ora della musica e tutti vogliono provare a suonare il tamburo, ma Bing e' impaziente e invece di aspettare il suo turno, strappa di mano a Sula il tamburo, rompendolo...

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing e Sula giocano a far volare in aria i loro pupazzi e quello di Sula rimane incastrato su un albero. Cosi' Bing lancia Hoppity per liberarlo, ma qualcosa va storto...

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: È il compleanno di Mamma Pig. Peppa, George e il papà preparano tante sorprese in segreto: la mamma adorerà la bellissima torta e rimarrà deliziata dal regalo.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa perde un dente. Mamma Pig le spiega che quella notte la Fatina dei dentini lo porterà via, lasciandole una moneta in cambio. Peppa decide di non dormire per aspettarla, ma restare sveglia è più difficile del previsto...

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: La macchina di Peppa si rompe. Nonno Cane la ripara e presta loro un'auto piena di pulsanti: uno apre il tetto e un altro schizza acqua su Papà Pig.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: I nonni organizzano una caccia al tesoro in giardino per Peppa e George. Seguendo mappa e indizi, i due maialini si divertono a cercare il bottino di monete di cioccolata.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa ha delle macchie rosse sul viso e deve stare a letto. Il medico la rassicura e, dato che non è contagiosa, i suoi amici vanno a trovarla.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa è triste, perché piove e non può uscire a giocare. Ma quando la pioggia cessa, Peppa e George si precipitano fuori per il loro divertimento preferito: saltare dentro le pozzanghere e sporcarsi di fango!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Il Signor Dinosauro, il giocattolo preferito di George, e' scomparso. E George e' distrutto. Papa' aiuta allora Peppa a indagare per ritrovarlo e far tornare il sorriso a George.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: George perde il Signor Dinosauro ed è triste. Aiutata da Papà Pig, Peppa si trasforma in detective: insieme ritrovano il gioco e il fratellino torna felice.

programme.title: Masha e Orso
programme.desc: Masha, grazie al giornale regalatole da Orsa, scopre qual e' il segreto per ottenere la vera bellezza. Decide cosi' di trovare la giusta pettinatura con l'aiuto di Orso.

programme.title: Masha e Orso
programme.desc: Mentre Masha aspetta di poter rientrare in casa, indossa un cappello magico che le permette di diventare invisibile. Riuscira' Orso a vederla?

programme.title: Zig & Sharko

programme.title: Reforma y Alquila
programme.desc: En este nuevo capítulo de 'Reforma y alquila' veremos un inmueble muy diferente: un estudio abuhardillado de tan solo 36 metros cuadrados en lo alto de un edificio. Con tan solo 12.000 euros de presupuesto, Patricia logrará transformar este piso de hace 20 años de una manera radical y aprovechando cada milímetro.

programme.title: La casa más top
programme.desc: Todas llaman hogar a los suburbios, pero ahí termina la similitud. Tres estilos radicalmente diferentes, que abarcan décadas, chocan para poner a prueba a los jueces.

programme.title: Tus plantas decoran
programme.desc: Hay plantas que creemos conocer… hasta que las miramos de verdad. Por eso, Natalia nos invita a redescubrir una de las más icónicas y versátiles: el anturium, y también el sorprendente mundo de las pequeñas y versátiles plantas de aire. A partir de ellas, nos sumergiremos en un taller muy especial para traer un toque marítimo al hogar, transformando una tillandsia en una delicada medusa vegetal. Además, aprenderemos dos fórmulas sencillas para crear un sustrato perfecto, capaz de ayudar a que nuestras plantas respiren, drenen y crezcan con fuerza. Disfruta de un capítulo lleno de creatividad y naturaleza en cualquier formato.

programme.title: Limpia y ordena
programme.desc: Mark Wright y el equipo de Limpia y ordena ayudan a Andrew a transformar su descuidado estudio en un hogar seguro y acogedor que pueda compartirlo con sus gatos. Con poco tiempo para las tareas domésticas y arreglos pendientes por todas partes, el espacio se ha vuelto incómodo y poco práctico. Maxine Dwyer limpia a fondo y devuelve el orden, mientras Mark y la carpintera, Amie Williams crean almacenaje a medida, sustituyen un armario peligroso y organizan la estancia en zonas para dormir, jugar y relajarse. Pintura nueva, iluminación mejorada, reciclaje creativo y un rincón para los gatos hacen que Andrew vuelva a sentirse orgulloso de su casa.

programme.title: Los Scott: Reforma bajo presión
programme.desc: Después de estar separados durante años, Michael y Yuni por fin pueden vivir juntos, pero encontrar una casa que les guste a los dos es más difícil de lo que pensaban. Sueñan con formar una familia, pero tienen poco dinero, así que buscan una casa antigua, aunque eso implica precios complicados y asumir problemas de mantenimiento que no pueden dejar pasar por alto. Jonathan y Drew les ayudan a evitar errores y lograr el comienzo que desean sin que la inversión sea un pozo sin fondo.

programme.title: De ruina a palacio
programme.sub-title: El renacer de la masía catalana
programme.desc: Viajamos a Cataluña para visitar dos masías centenarias rehabilitadas tras años de abandono. Rafa nos muestra un refugio que conserva las huellas del pasado en su jardín y estructura, mientras que Oriol nos enseña cómo una ruina total se convirtió en un hogar de ensueño donde el diseño y la calma se unen en un paisaje privilegiado.

programme.title: Reforma Integral
programme.desc: En este programa, el arquitecto Joaquín Millán duplicará, literalmente, el espacio de una vivienda. Donde antes sólo había una planta, conseguirá sacar dos. En su estado actual, la casa es un solo espacio, un rectángulo donde prácticamente no hay nada, como si fuera una caja de zapatos enorme, muy alta y con mucha luz. La propietaria, Leda, quiere meter un montón de cosas en su nuevo hogar. Está en un momento de cambio personal y quiere empezar una nueva etapa con su hijo. Seguro que ni te imaginas el cambiazo que va a dar esta casa. Si quieres verlo, ¡te merece la pena quedarte!

programme.title: Minicasas sorprendentes
programme.sub-title: Una minicasa con historia y otra étnica
programme.desc: Raquel paseaba por el parque volcánico de La Garrotxa (Girona) cuando se encontró una antigua vivienda de la que se enamoró. Decidió reformarla junto a su marido para convertirla en una minicasa acogedora y tranquila en medio esta zona natural. Víctor llegó por unos amigos hasta las cumbres de Alcalalí (Alicante) y allí decidió construir esta preciosa casita de dos módulos sostenibles y ecológicos con vistas panorámicas al mar y la montaña, que ha decorado con toques biográficos de sus viajes por otros continentes.

programme.title: El arte de los artesanos
programme.desc: Joan Montero es un escultor y tallista de la madera que lleva toda una vida dedicada a elaborar piezas decorativas y religiosas desde su taller en Olot (Girona). Montse Casas confecciona con su telar artesanal delicadas prendas y complementos para el hogar en su taller ubicado en el Poble Espanyol de Barcelona. Los hermanos Mora Bonadona continúan la saga familiar centenaria que ha contribuido a dar forma a la tradición de la alfarería negra desde su taller en Quart (Girona).

programme.title: La cocina de tus sueños 2.0
programme.desc: En el programa de hoy Alejandro se enfrenta a una ambiciosa reforma de cocina. La propietaria quiere tirar nada menos que dos paredes, la que da con el salón y la que da con una habitación de servicio y un cuarto de baño. En principio, el proyecto resulta prometedor pero nuestro profesional se va a encontrar con una larga 'lista de deseos' de la dueña que le va a provocar muchos quebraderos de cabeza. Quiere contentarla, pero le quedan muy pocos tabiques para colocar todas las peticiones. Veremos cómo sale de este atolladero.

programme.title: Minipisos asombrosos
programme.desc: Llega uno de nuestros momentos favoritos. Nos encanta cuando alguien se propone transformar una triste buhardilla en un encantador minipiso. Julio nos espera para subir a lo alto de un céntrico edificio y mostrarnos el trabajo que han hecho. Después conoceremos a Eva, una fanática del almacenaje que ha diseñado un minipiso en el que no falta espacio para guardar cosas. Además, ha tenido una original idea para separar la cocina del salón. ¿Queréis verla?

programme.title: Redecora con Raquel
programme.desc: Natalia necesita desesperadamente cambiar el cabecero de su cama, una pieza familiar con historia que no le gusta y que da un estilo demasiado rústico al dormitorio. Raquel Regueras tendrá que ingeniárselas para dar un vuelco a este pequeño espacio y conseguir una decoración más acogedora, ayudándose de las paredes y los volúmenes.

programme.title: El arte de los artesanos
programme.desc: Sergi Cadenas constituye la quinta generación de una saga de artesanos que lleva trabajando la forja artística desde la época del novecentismo en su taller de Gerona. David Echevarría es el último represente en Naval (Huesca) de una familia de alfareros que hunde sus raíces en el siglo XIX y cuyo trabajo mantiene viva la alfarería tradicional navalesa. Pepi Sánchez está especializada en la adaptación a miniatura de piezas de la cestería popular catalana, para coleccionistas y casas de muñecas, a través de su proyecto ubicado en el Poble Espanyol de Barcelona.

programme.title: La cocina de tus sueños 2.0
programme.desc: En el programa de hoy, la propietaria, aunque tiene una cocina que parece nueva, después de cuatro años viviendo en la casa, quiere cambiarla por completo. Eso incluye unirla con el salón. A Alejandro el plan le parece estupendo, pero no tardan en llegar las complicaciones. Los deseos de la dueña chocan con problemas técnicos ineludibles. Un proyecto que en principio era prometedor para nuestro profesional, se convierte en uno de los más complicados de su carrera. Veremos cómo sortea los obstáculos.

programme.title: Reforma y Alquila
programme.desc: Patricia tiene un nuevo encargo: reformar una vivienda con gran potencial. Ubicada en pleno centro de la ciudad, con vistas al mar y dos terrazas excepcionales, la propiedad tiene todos los ingredientes para atraer a un inquilino exigente. La reforma no estará exenta de retos, pero el resultado merecerá la pena.

programme.title: Hoteles increíbles. La vida más allá del vestíbulo
programme.desc: En la región del Tirol, al norte de Italia, se encuentra el Hotel Hubertus, un complejo de gestión familiar que ofrece espectaculares vistas de las montañas circundantes gracias a su aspecto panorámico. La arquitectura de este hotel es digna de admiración, con ángulos espectaculares dondequiera que se mire. Rob y Monica trabajan entre bastidores en el exclusivo spa 'Heaven and Hell', limpian la piscina suspendida, dirigen excursiones por la montaña y conocen a la familia que está detrás de todo esto.

programme.title: Los Scott: Reforma bajo presión

Sin embargo, la situación cada vez es más tensa y su posibilidades de compra disminuyen, razón por la que se confían a Jonathan y Drew para que les ayuden a conseguir llegar a hacer realidad sus deseos y que estos y la tranquilidad estén en equilibrio.
